verdicts.reason: A is the whole original shrunk to fit and dropped into the middle of the 9:16 canvas. The label is intact and readable, but about 30% of the height above it and 30% below is empty beige, and nothing was rearranged for the tall format. B is broken: all the text has been pulled out of the label, which now sits as an empty white frame with only stray rule lines. 'J'adore Paris' and 'LAVANDER' sit in a ragged row at the top, 'SKINCARE' is tiny, 'HOMEMADE LOTION' is shrunk and placed below the frame, and the illustrations have become a strip of tiny scattered icons with large empty areas around them.
